svg.title: System comparison by bandwidth and error rate
svg.desc: Four panels compare simulated and theoretical BER, RF bandwidth, the BER requirement at 8 dB and the BPSK channel test at 6 dB.

cc:Work.dc:title: System comparison by bandwidth and error rate
cc:Work.dc:description: Simulated bit error rates, theoretical comparison curves, bandwidth at equal gross bit rate and errors in the multipath channel.
